segments.title: 第174章 欠收拾了
segments.content:
Chapter 174: Asking for a Thrashing

Starting from 3:30 in the afternoon, Li Luo accompanied Xu Youyu, strolling along Houde Road from one stall to another.

There was a Calligraphy Club, where Xu Youyu picked up a brush and wrote a very beautiful "Li Luo" on the Xuan paper, clearly showing she had a foundation in calligraphy.

In comparison, the "Xu Youyu" that Li Luo wrote looked much more ordinary.

Of course, if he wanted to, by frequently observing the techniques of calligraphy masters and using his soul possession effect, he could write exceptionally beautiful characters with a brush.

But he had already used soul possession many times today, and his head was a little tired, so he didn't expend the extra energy.

After that, there were the Photography Club, Anime Club, and Dance Club.

There was even a Chinese Chess Club, which had set up a few endgame puzzles at their stall. Completing one would earn you a stamp.

The two of them wandered for about an hour, finally making their way from the north end of Houde Road to the very south end, returning to the entrance of the gymnasium.

At this moment, Xu Youyu stopped walking and suddenly looked under the shade of a nearby tree, then walked over and crouched down.

"Senior, what's wrong?"

Li Luo walked over curiously, only to find it was a stray cat.

"Hello, Mimi," Xu Youyu said, crouching on the ground and greeting the tabby cat before her.

She didn't dare to reach out and pet it, though, only calling the kitten's name very affectionately, well... if its name really was Mimi.

"I've seen this cat many times before," Xu Youyu said. "It seems to have been at the school since last semester. This is the first time I've seen it this semester."

"A stray cat?"

"The answer is obvious." Xu Youyu watched as the small tabby cat darted into the bushes and disappeared from sight, then stood up and patted her bottom. "I heard it was chased away by security before the summer break. I didn't expect it to sneak back in this semester."

"Senior must really like cats, right?" Li Luo remembered very clearly that in his past life, Xu Youyu had raised two cats, one tabby and one Ragdoll.

Back when Xu Youyu was sick in bed, it was Li Luo who had gone to her home to refill the cat food.

"I like them, but my parents don't." Xu Youyu smiled helplessly, then clenched her fists. "But once I start earning money in the future, I'll live by myself, and then I can have a cat."

"It's not impossible to get one now." Li Luo said, pointing at himself, "Your current landlord is right here."

"You like cats too?" Xu Youyu asked curiously.

"They're alright, at least I don't dislike them."

"Then let's forget it." Xu Youyu shook her head. "Raising a cat is still quite troublesome, and we usually have to go to school. Let's talk about this kind of thing in the future."

"I thought you'd happily agree," Li Luo said, a little surprised.

"What kind of person do you take me for?" Xu Youyu shot him a look. "Am I that indiscreet?"

"For someone who enters my room first thing in the morning and wants to undress right in front of me, you should indeed be considered quite indiscreet," Li Luo said with a straight face.

"Heh, you clearly wanted to watch, didn't you." Xu Youyu looked at him sideways. "When we were playing basketball just now, your eyes never moved away."

"Don't you slander me!" Li Luo argued righteously. "At most, I glanced a couple of times, and then I focused on playing."

"See, you admitted it," Xu Youyu smiled triumphantly. "You did look after all."

Li Luo: "...Senior, you really are cunningly sharp."

She was far from being as easy to fool as Ying Chanxi and Yan Zhusheng; she was so slick with her words.

After watching the cat and finishing their idle chat at the gymnasium entrance, the two of them went back inside.

Li Luo had originally wanted to find Yan Zhusheng on his way, but he didn't see her.

Instead, Qian Siliang from the second year had come to take over, teaching the keyboard in place of Xie Shuchen, so Xie Shuchen came to teach guitar.

Yan Zhusheng was nowhere to be seen.

"President, where's Yan Zhusheng?" Li Luo asked Niu Qingling, who was in front of the drum set.

"Your classmates called her out to hang out," Niu Qingling said. "Didn't you run into her?"

"No." Li Luo shook his head, then said his goodbyes and walked with Xu Youyu towards the sports field. "Let's go over there and have a look."

He remembered that he had promised Ying Chanxi he would go find her at the picnic spot after he was done. Since Yan Zhusheng had been dragged off to play by her classmates, Li Luo decided to simply take Xu Youyu to sit with Ying Chanxi for a while.

After walking to the southwest corner of the sports field, the two of them easily found Ying Chanxi, who had spread a picnic blanket by the sports field bleachers.

Besides Qiao Xinyan, Yan Zhusheng and Xu Yinghuan were also there, surprisingly.

The four of them were sitting in a circle, playing poker.

Seeing the grave expressions on their faces, it seemed to be a pretty intense game.

Li Luo walked right up to the picnic blanket, crouched behind Ying Chanxi, and glanced at her cards for a moment, unable to resist reaching out and asking, "Wouldn't playing this one work?"

"Ah!"

Startled by the hand that suddenly reached out, Ying Chanxi almost dropped her cards.

She turned her head to see it was Li Luo and her face immediately fell, her expression turning gloomy. "Are you trying to get killed? You didn't even say anything when you came over."

"Didn't I just say something?"

"You call suddenly reaching out from behind me a greeting?"

"My bad. You go ahead and play your card."

"Hmph." Ying Chanxi turned back around, pondered for a long while, and finally played the card Li Luo had just pointed out.

"See, you still played what I said..."

"Shut up." Ying Chanxi glared at him, seeming to be in a bad mood.

Xu Yinghuan, on the other hand, asked curiously while playing her cards, "Class President, what were you up to all afternoon? When I went to the Rock Club to find Zhusheng, I didn't see you."

"He went with the senior to the basketball court to watch a fight," Yan Zhusheng said, her eyes focused on the cards in her hand, answering on Li Luo's behalf.

"I was accompanying the president to handle the fight incident," Li Luo said with a straight face.

"And then you never came back," Yan Zhusheng said, turning to stare at him for a moment before quickly turning back to her cards.

"I was..."

"That's because he insisted on begging me to play basketball," Xu Youyu said with a giggle. "We played for a little under half an hour, then went to browse the stalls over there. After that, we came to find you."

"Oh, so that's how it was." Ying Chanxi glanced at Li Luo, remembering what Qiao Xinyan had said earlier, and immediately let out a light hmph. "Someone's New Year's Gala is quite fulfilling."

"You should focus on your cards." Li Luo pointed to the Ace in her hand. "Play this one."

"This is the only high card I have left!" Ying Chanxi frowned. "Don't give bad directions."

"I can tell you haven't been keeping track of the cards," Li Luo shot her a look. "None of the three of them have any 2s left, and the jokers have all been played. This is the highest single card you have, just play it to take the trick."

"What if there's still a bomb?"

"The cards on the table can't form a bomb, trust me."

Ying Chanxi looked at him suspiciously, but in the end, she trusted him and played the Ace in her hand.

As it turned out, no one could beat it.

And so, Ying Chanxi very smoothly won the round.

"Hey, hey, hey! Class President, stop giving outside help!" Xu Yinghuan immediately wailed. "How can you not help a classmate and help someone else instead!"

"Yinghuan, you must accept your loss," Ying Chanxi said with a slight smile, her mood suddenly improving quite a bit. "Hurry up."

"Mmph..." Xu Yinghuan was a bit reluctant, but she finally crouched on the picnic blanket, opened her mouth, and barked, "Woof woof woof!"

Li Luo: "...You have to bark like a dog if you lose? Who came up with this?"

"It was Xixi who said it," Xu Yinghuan said indignantly.

Hearing this, Li Luo immediately looked at Ying Chanxi with a strange expression, a faint smile on his face. "You're not trying to use this method to practice how it feels, are you?"

"Don't spout nonsense here." Ying Chanxi guiltily averted her gaze and secretly pinched Li Luo, telling him to stop talking nonsense.

Li Luo yelped in pain and quickly held down her small hand, prying her fingers open.

Behind their backs, their two hands were entangled, swatting at each other.

In the end, Ying Chanxi's small hand was no match for Li Luo's large one, and she conceded defeat, pulling it back.

"Do Li Luo and Senior want to join?" Having lost the round, Xu Yinghuan was in charge of shuffling the cards. She looked at the two newcomers and asked, "We can play Old Maid."

"And the loser has to bark like a dog?" Li Luo raised his eyebrows.

"Ahem... let's forget that one." Ying Chanxi quickly rejected it. "Let's change it."

"Let me think." Xu Yinghuan thought for a moment, then had a flash of inspiration, snapped her fingers, and suggested, "Then the loser has to tell an embarrassing story about themselves. How about that?"

Li Luo looked at Xu Yinghuan with a speechless expression. "You have such a wicked sense of humor."

"What's wrong? Isn't this quite interesting," Xu Yinghuan chuckled. "Class President, are you scared?"

"Bring it on." Li Luo chuckled. "I'm not going to lose anyway."

A few minutes later.

Only Li Luo and Ying Chanxi were left with cards on the field.

Li Luo had one card, while Ying Chanxi had two, one of which was the joker.

Watching Ying Chanxi nervously clutching the only two cards left in her hand, Li Luo reached out and pinched one of them, as if to test her reaction.

Then, he keenly noticed a flash of joy pass through Ying Chanxi's eyes.

So he let out a soft chuckle and drew the other card.

But when he looked at the card he drew, his face instantly darkened.

Meanwhile, Ying Chanxi on the other side was beaming with joy, quickly urging Li Luo to get ready.

So this time, it was Li Luo holding two cards, and it was Ying Chanxi's turn to draw.

Ying Chanxi wasn't as fond of testing the waters as Li Luo. She simply drew one at random, taking away the last good card and leaving behind a twitchy-eyed Li Luo.

"I suddenly remembered that I still have to go practice with the Rock Club. We have a gala performance to prepare for tonight."

"Why are you running!" Ying Chanxi grabbed his arm, not letting him go.

Yan Zhusheng, who was next to them, also said seriously, "We have already practiced the performance pieces for the gala very well. We don't need to practice again today."

"So, what embarrassing stories do you have?" Xu Youyu asked with a curious face. "You look like you don't want to say anything."

"I'll talk, I'll talk." Li Luo raised his hands in surrender and said with a sincere look, "I wet the bed when I was four. That should be okay, right?"

"What does that count for? Isn't it normal for kids to wet the bed?"

"Then, when I was in elementary school, I wore mismatched shoes to school, one different on each foot."

"Hmm... that's okay, I guess, but it doesn't feel explosive enough."

"...You guys really have high standards." Li Luo looked speechless, then gritted his teeth. "I walked into the wrong women's restroom in middle school."

"Wow."

"Not bad."

"Barely passes, I suppose."

"Actually, I have an explosive one," Ying Chanxi said, holding back a laugh. "When Li Luo was in elementary school, he wore..."

"Ying Chanxi! Shut your mouth!" Hearing her say this, Li Luo knew what kind of filth was about to come out of this little dog's mouth and quickly reached out to cover it.

"Mmph! Mmph mmph!" Ying Chanxi couldn't speak with her mouth covered, but she eventually struggled free. "When Li Luo was in elementary school, he wore my little dress, hahaha!"

"He even said it was too hot in the summer and that he was envious that girls could wear skirts, so he insisted on trying on mine."

"His mom even took a picture of him to commemorate it. It's in their family photo album."

Li Luo: "...Ying Chanxi, you have courted death."

The other girls next to them were all holding back their laughter.

Xu Youyu patted his shoulder comfortingly, "That's quite cute, has a very innocent feel to it."

"Again!" Li Luo gathered the cards on the picnic blanket, his fighting spirit soaring. "Every one of you just wait!"

"No more, no more, it's getting late," Ying Chanxi said, standing up and patting her bottom.

"Mhm," Yan Zhusheng said with a straight face. "I think we should still go practice one more time before the gala performance."

"Ahem." Xu Youyu also got up and stretched. "I need to go on patrol again, in case any other emergencies pop up."

"Are you scared?"

"Scared, scared." Xu Yinghuan admitted defeat very readily, giggling as she hugged Yan Zhusheng's arm, waved at Li Luo, and slipped away.

"Thank you." Qiao Xinyan took the deck of cards Li Luo had just gathered from his hand, trying hard to stifle her laughter and keeping a straight face as she said, "Don't worry, I won't tell anyone."

"Heh, hehe... then I should be thanking you all, shouldn't I?"

(End of this chapter)
